oracle_rules.condition: swagger.json returns a sizable JSON spec (>=40% larger than 404 payload)
Spec contains host/basePath/example server values that match observed request host or reflect request parameters

test_cases.notes: High-value: fetch API spec first to reveal endpoints, auth requirements, schemas. Stop further probing on 401/403 unless spec reveals public endpoints.

prerequisites.description: Run after EXEC-01; skip if swagger.json returned full spec with endpoints
prerequisites.custom_logic: If EXEC-01 yields usable spec, deprioritize this request.

oracle_rules.condition: Endpoint returns 200 or 301 (not 404) indicating docs accessible
Response content size is large (>50% vs 404) suggesting full documentation served

test_cases.notes: Supplementary docs retrieval if swagger.json incomplete. Abort if rate limit or 403 encountered repeatedly.

prerequisites.description: Run after discovery; include Referer and User-Agent same as prior requests
prerequisites.custom_logic: If swagger.json indicates this resource is static, mark as low priority.

oracle_rules.condition: Response body size differs by >=20% from typical 404 baseline or contains non-error content
Returned status is 200 or 301 instead of 404 indicating reachable resource

test_cases.notes: Quick check for embedded static resource; useful for fingerprinting

prerequisites.description: If swagger.json indicated auth scheme, include no-auth first then include observed auth header/cookie if found in context
prerequisites.custom_logic: Compare unauthenticated vs authenticated responses; abort enumeration if 401 returned consistently.

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains arrays or objects representing multiple users with PII-like fields
Response size is substantially larger than typical error page (>50%) indicating bulk data

test_cases.notes: High-impact enumeration for PII; run early after discovery. If returns 200 unauthenticated, escalate to detailed sensitive-data tests.

prerequisites.description: Run unauthenticated then authenticated (if token/cookie discovered) to find PII exposures
prerequisites.custom_logic: Extract any user fields (name,email,id) for use in later targeted tests; stop if response is 401.

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains PII-like keys such as name, email, phone, address in unauthenticated response
Status code remains 200 for unauthenticated access or differs between auth and unauth contexts

test_cases.notes: Use extracted identifiers for correlating findings; if unauthenticated 200, raise priority for data exposure chain.

prerequisites.description: Unauthenticated then authenticated if possible; include Accept header for image types to detect content negotiation
prerequisites.custom_logic: If response includes links, queue GETs for listed media paths later under media retrieval controls.

oracle_rules.condition: Unauthenticated response includes picture metadata or direct links to media revealing user content
Large response size consistent with media listing (>40% difference)

test_cases.notes: If media links enumerated, limit follow-up media fetches to 10 and respect content-size thresholds to avoid bandwidth abuse.

prerequisites.description: Run after EXEC-05 to reuse any user identifiers to look for user-specific images
prerequisites.custom_logic: If identifiers found, append query tokens per swagger spec if applicable.

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains image URLs, base64 images, or user-identifying metadata in unauthenticated response
Payload size suggests media content (>=40% larger than error pages)

test_cases.notes: Targeted media check; follow-up only if prior enumeration indicates exposure.

prerequisites.description: Unauthenticated then authenticated if possible; abort if swagger indicates this is an admin-only endpoint
prerequisites.custom_logic: Treat any 200 unauthenticated response as high-severity and escalate exploitation attempts for auth bypass.

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains financial fields like balance, total_money, amount, currency without auth
Status code remains 200 when unauthenticated indicating exposure

test_cases.notes: High-impact; if returns sensitive data, pause other probes and notify.

payloads.description: DOM XSS probe delivered to SPA entry point to detect reflection or template injection.

prerequisites.description: Execute after discovery and initial unauthenticated enumeration; include any cookies/tokens found in prior responses for authenticated context if present
prerequisites.custom_logic: If login page includes anti-CSRF tokens in HTML, extract and bind to later POSTs; otherwise proceed with probes.

oracle_rules.condition: Response body contains unescaped injected payload or scriptable fragment
Response body length increases by >=15% compared to baseline when payload provided

test_cases.notes: Low-impact XSS probes on SPA entry; monitor DOM execution via instrumentation if available.

payloads.description: Upload a small benign text file as multipart to observe server handling and error messages.
Path-traversal style filename to trigger server-side errors or inclusion attempts (benign payload).

prerequisites.description: If prior discovery reveals auth or CSRF tokens, bind them into headers/cookies/form fields; otherwise attempt unauthenticated upload first
prerequisites.custom_logic: On successful upload, capture returned file URL for OOB follow-up; limit retries to avoid storage abuse.

oracle_rules.condition: Server returns 4xx/5xx with stack trace or detailed error message referencing file handling
Out-of-band HTTP interaction observed after upload indicating server processed external URL or inclusion

test_cases.notes: Conservative upload attempts; do not upload large binaries. If responses indicate unauthorized, stop further upload attempts.
